help.title: Help center
help.savingBody: Single preferences save when you select them. Wait for the saved message. Forms such as profile details and demographic information use a Save button. If saving cannot be confirmed, reload settings to check the current value before retrying. Form changes remain available while you stay on the screen.
help.privacyBody: Use Account privacy and interaction to control your account visibility, discovery, reposts, invitations and tags. Groups shown on my profile controls the membership list. View my public profile shows what a visitor is allowed to see.
help.notificationsTitle: Why am I not receiving notifications?
help.notificationsBody: Check event preferences and the device notification channel, then allow notifications in your browser or device settings. Quiet hours pause device notifications during the selected time. Your in-app notification history remains available.
help.accessTitle: How do I protect or recover my account?
help.accessBody: Keep a verified email and an available sign-in method. Review your signed-in devices in Security and sessions. If you cannot sign in, use Forgot password on the sign-in screen for a password account.
help.safetyTitle: How do I report a problem with content?
help.safetyBody: Open the content options and choose Report, then select the reason. You can manage blocked accounts in Privacy and interaction. Review a post’s audience before publishing information you do not want to share publicly.
